sources.title: Fine-Tuning Qwen 2.5 3B for Realistic Movie Dialogue Generation
sources.snippet: The Qwen 2.5 3B base model was fine-tuned to generate contextually rich and engaging movie dialogue, leveraging the Cornell Movie-Dialog Corpus, a curated dataset of movie conversations. Due to the limitations in GPU computing and VRAM, the training process began with the 0.5B model progressively scaling up to the 1.5B and 3B versions as efficiency improvements were implemented.
